title: ticfac's integrated gate never re-runs the repo's CI workflow steps, so a workflow naming a deleted package is invisible to every green gate
body: The pwp run merged five ticks whose integrated gates were green while the repo's own ci.yml named a package tick nkf had deleted; the review phase caught it, no gate did. The gate's command set and the workflow's step set are different authorities that drift independently. ticfac's gate should either run the workflow's named-package steps verbatim on the integrated SHA, or validate that every package a repo's CI names exists before declaring a merge green.
